why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://raflux.io/quests   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Open raflux.io/quests and sign in with Google or a wallet. "Google sign-in: Privy creates an embedded Solana wallet for your account. No wallet extension is required."
Do the one-off quests: connect X, connect Telegram and verify your email.
Check in every day to keep the streak, and do the X tasks while they're up.
Share your referral link from the Refer and Earn page if you want. "Self-referral is not permitted."
